external.note: The consuming project's GR2 and texture tools, found by walking up from the scripts or from AOE3_UNIT_CONSUMER_ROOT: <consumer-root>/scripts/havok/gr2_read.py and gr2_dump.py (reader), gr2_lint.py (.material and archive texture sizes), gr2_fixups.py, gr2_reskeleton.py and rig_table.py (the Blender GXO writer), and <consumer-root>/scripts/tools/ddt_read.py (DXT1 decode).

The owner's GR2 converter under Wine in WSL (gxo-convert) for model GXOs of vanilla files (the horse) used by pose_sim.py (clips are decoded by clip_decode.py: a converter clip dump is a pose at key 0 only), for FBX inputs to skinned-model-check, and for the G0 route-B specimen. Never launched on the Windows host.
Readable retail AoE3 DE .bar archives, read in memory and extracted into a temp folder; never into a repository. Auto-detection may need an explicit AOE3DE_GAME.

Background Blender (blender -b, tested 5.1) runs donor_to_blend.py and rig_table.py, and the generic blender-organic-modeling/scripts/tangent_compare.py that scripts/tangent_compare.py calls; found through BLENDER, the consumer's config/tool-paths.local.json or PATH.
Array maths in every script (Blender bundles its own).
shape_metrics.py uses a KD-tree for the symmetry search when SciPy is present and falls back to numpy.
